```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Knit from reports/; everything below runs from the project root.
root <- normalizePath("..")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
devtools::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

usd  <- function(x) scales::dollar(round(x))
usdk <- function(x) ifelse(abs(x) >= 1e6, paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 2), "M"),
                           paste0("$", round(x / 1e3), "K"))
pct  <- function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")
```

# {.tabset}

## FY28

**Can we hold churn to plan this year?** On the current pipeline the model gives a
**`r pct(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])`** chance of finishing FY28 at or under the
**`r usd(plan_fy)`** company churn plan. Hitting plan is `r verdict(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])`.

```{r fy-cards, results = "asis"}
card <- function(lbl, v, sub) sprintf(
  '<div style="flex:1;min-width:160px;background:#F7F7F5;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 16px">
   <div style="font-size:12px;color:#666;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em">%s</div>
   <div style="font-size:26px;font-weight:700">%s</div><div style="font-size:12px;color:#888">%s</div></div>',
  lbl, v, sub)
cat('<div style="display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 18px">',
    card("Company plan", usdk(plan_fy), "FY28 churn, four quarters"),
    card("Best case (P25)", usdk(fy$P25), sprintf("%s vs plan", ifelse(fy$P25 > plan_fy, paste("+", usdk(fy$P25 - plan_fy)), paste("\u2212", usdk(plan_fy - fy$P25))))),
    card("Most likely (P50)", usdk(fy$P50), sprintf("%s vs plan", ifelse(fy$P50 > plan_fy, paste("+", usdk(fy$P50 - plan_fy)), paste("\u2212", usdk(plan_fy - fy$P50))))),
    card("Worst case (P75)", usdk(fy$P75), sprintf("%s vs plan", ifelse(fy$P75 > plan_fy, paste("+", usdk(fy$P75 - plan_fy)), paste("\u2212", usdk(plan_fy - fy$P75))))),
    '</div>')
```

**What the percentiles say.** Across `r format(params$n_sims, big.mark = ",")` simulated
years, FY28 churn comes in at `r usd(fy$P25)` in the best case (25th percentile),
`r usd(fy$P50)` most likely (50th percentile) and `r usd(fy$P75)` in the worst case
(75th percentile). The plan of `r usd(plan_fy)` sits at the
`r round(100 * fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])`th percentile of the distribution: in
`r pct(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])` of simulated years churn stays at or under plan,
and in `r pct(1 - fy[["Chance at or under plan"]])` it overshoots.

**What's already locked in.** `r usd(certain_fy)` of FY28 churn is certain (Closed Lost,
Verbally Confirmed or Will Churn renewals), which uses
`r pct(certain_fy / plan_fy)` of the annual plan before any at-risk renewal is lost.

**Quarter by quarter.** `r best_q` has the best chance of landing at or under plan
(`r pct(stats[best_q, "Chance at or under plan"])`); `r worst_q` the weakest
(`r pct(stats[worst_q, "Chance at or under plan"])`).

```{r fy-table}
tab <- stats %>%
  transmute(Period, Plan = usd(Plan), `Expected (mean)` = usd(Expected),
            `Best case (P25)` = usd(P25), `Most likely (P50)` = usd(P50), `Worst case (P75)` = usd(P75),
            `Chance at or under plan` = pct(`Chance at or under plan`))
knitr::kable(tab, row.names = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("r", 6)))
```

<small>**Method.** Each renewal is an independent coin flip: Closed Lost, Verbally
Confirmed and Will Churn always churn; Expected to Churn churns with probability
`r p[1]`; At Risk Renewal with probability `r p[2]`; Expecting to Renew and Closed Won
are not modelled. Q1 and Q2 come from Salesforce renewals in the
`r snap_date` snapshot (certain and expected churn valued at
`r params$sf_amount_field`, at-risk at Amount); Q3 and Q4 use the hand-entered amounts
from `scripts/FY28_churn_forecast.R`. The year is the sum of the four quarters in each
run. Plan figures are `load_constants()$churn_plan`.</small>

```{r quarter-helpers}
quarter_intro <- function(q) {
  s <- stats[q, ]; x <- fc[[q]]
  b <- x$table %>% group_by(Bucket) %>% summarise(n = n(), v = sum(`Modelled $`), .groups = "drop")
  g <- function(k) { r <- b[b$Bucket == k, ]; if (nrow(r)) sprintf("%d (%s)", r$n, usdk(r$v)) else "none" }
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
    "**%s chance of landing at or under the %s plan.** Best case (P25) %s, most likely (P50) %s, worst case (P75) %s; expected %s.\n\nInputs (%s): certain churn %s, expected to churn %s, at risk %s.\n\n",
    pct(s$`Chance at or under plan`), usd(s$Plan), usd(s$P25), usd(s$P50), usd(s$P75), usd(s$Expected),
    x$source, g("Certain churn"), g("Expected to churn"), g("At risk")))
}
show_png <- function(path, q, param) {
  if (!nzchar(path)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
      "> *Renewal ratings PNG for %s goes here. Set `%s` in the YAML header at the top of this file.*\n\n",
      q, param)))
  }
  full <- if (file.exists(path)) path else file.path(root, path)
  if (!file.exists(full)) {
    return(knitr::asis_output(sprintf("> *PNG not found: `%s` (set in `%s`).*\n\n", path, param)))
  }
  knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(full), rel_path = FALSE)
}
renewal_table <- function(q) {
  t <- fc[[q]]$table %>%
    arrange(factor(Bucket, c("Certain churn", "Expected to churn", "At risk", "Not modelled")), desc(Amount)) %>%
    mutate(Amount = usd(Amount), `Modelled $` = usd(`Modelled $`),
           `Chance of churn` = case_when(Bucket == "Certain churn" ~ "100%",
                                         Bucket == "Expected to churn" ~ pct(p[1]),
                                         Bucket == "At risk" ~ pct(p[2]), TRUE ~ "—"))
  if (all(is.na(t$Account))) t$Account <- NULL
  knitr::kable(t, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Churn distribution

Hover for values; click a line or bar in the legend to hide it. In the cumulative
chart, click any point to pin its churn value and percentile.

### FY28 total churn

```{r dist-fy}
qs <- c(P25 = fy$P25, P50 = fy$P50, P75 = fy$P75)
vline <- function(x, col, dash) list(type = "line", x0 = x, x1 = x, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
                                      line = list(color = col, dash = dash, width = 2))
lab <- function(x, txt, col, y) list(x = x, y = y, yref = "paper", text = txt, showarrow = FALSE,
                                     xanchor = "left", font = list(color = col, size = 12))
plot_ly(x = sims_fy, type = "histogram", nbinsx = 60,
        marker = list(color = "#9CA3AF", line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 0.5)),
        hovertemplate = "Churn %{x}<br>%{y} simulated years<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Simulated FY28 churn", tickformat = "$,.2s"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Simulated years"),
    bargap = 0.02,
    shapes = list(vline(plan_fy, "#111111", "solid"),
                  vline(qs[["P25"]], "#16A34A", "dash"),
                  vline(qs[["P50"]], "#F59E0B", "dash"),
                  vline(qs[["P75"]], "#DC2626", "dash")),
    annotations = list(
      lab(plan_fy, paste0(" Plan ", usdk(plan_fy), " (", pct(fy[["Chance at or under plan"]]), " at or under)"), "#111111", 1.04),
      lab(qs[["P25"]], paste(" P25 best case", usdk(qs[["P25"]])), "#16A34A", 0.96),
      lab(qs[["P50"]], paste(" P50 most likely", usdk(qs[["P50"]])), "#B45309", 0.88),
      lab(qs[["P75"]], paste(" P75 worst case", usdk(qs[["P75"]])), "#DC2626", 0.80)),
    margin = list(t = 50)
  )
```

### Cumulative distribution by quarter

The diamond on each line is that quarter's plan: its height is the chance of
landing at or under plan.

```{r dist-ecdf}
plan_pts <- data.frame(Quarter = quarters, Plan = unname(plan),
                       Pct = sapply(quarters, function(q) mean(sims[[q]] <= plan[[q]])))
.forecast_ecdf_plot(sims, title = "") %>%
  add_trace(data = plan_pts, x = ~Plan, y = ~Pct, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
            inherit = FALSE, name = "Plan",
            marker = list(symbol = "diamond", size = 12, color = "#111111", line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1)),
            text = ~Quarter,
            hovertemplate = "%{text} plan $%{x:,.0f}<br>%{y:.0%} chance at or under plan<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Simulated quarterly churn", tickformat = "$,.2s"))
```

### Spread by quarter against plan

```{r dist-box}
long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(quarters, function(q) data.frame(Quarter = q, Churn = sims[[q]])))
plot_ly(long, x = ~Quarter, y = ~Churn, type = "box", name = "Simulated churn",
        boxpoints = FALSE, fillcolor = "#E5E7EB", line = list(color = "#6B7280"),
        hoverinfo = "y") %>%
  add_trace(data = plan_pts, x = ~Quarter, y = ~Plan, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
            inherit = FALSE, name = "Plan",
            marker = list(symbol = "diamond", size = 13, color = "#111111"),
            hovertemplate = "%{x} plan $%{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  add_trace(data = stats[quarters, ], x = quarters, y = ~P50, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
            inherit = FALSE, name = "P50 most likely",
            marker = list(symbol = "line-ew-open", size = 30, color = "#F59E0B", line = list(width = 3)),
            hovertemplate = "%{x} P50 most likely $%{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Simulated churn", tickformat = "$,.2s"), xaxis = list(title = ""))
```

### Chance of landing at or under plan

```{r dist-prob}
pp <- stats %>% mutate(Period = factor(Period, levels = c(quarters, "FY28")))
plot_ly(pp, x = ~Period, y = ~`Chance at or under plan`, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = ifelse(pp$`Chance at or under plan` >= .5, "#16A34A", "#DC2626")),
        text = ~pct(`Chance at or under plan`), textposition = "outside",
        hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y:.0%}<extra></extra>") %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Chance at or under plan", tickformat = ".0%", range = c(0, 1.1)),
         xaxis = list(title = ""),
         shapes = list(list(type = "line", x0 = -0.5, x1 = 4.5, y0 = .5, y1 = .5,
                            line = list(dash = "dot", color = "#9CA3AF"))))
```
